# Keyboard shortcuts

The same list as **?** in the app. "`g` then `o`" means: press `g`, then `o` within a second; "or" means either key works. On a Turkish Q keyboard the shortcuts follow the key's position, so `ğ` `ü` `.` work as `[` `]` `/`. Shortcuts don't fire while you type in a text field.

## Global

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| <kbd>⌘</kbd> then <kbd>K</kbd> | Open command palette |
| <kbd>?</kbd> | Open this cheat sheet |
| <kbd>Esc</kbd> | Close the active modal / palette |

## Navigate

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| <kbd>g</kbd> then <kbd>o</kbd> | Go to Overview (admins only) |
| <kbd>g</kbd> then <kbd>n</kbd> | Go to Nodes (admins only) |
| <kbd>g</kbd> then <kbd>d</kbd> | Go to Dashboard |
| <kbd>g</kbd> then <kbd>a</kbd> | Go to Admin (admins only) |

## Theme

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| <kbd>t</kbd> then <kbd>l</kbd> | Theme → Light |
| <kbd>t</kbd> then <kbd>d</kbd> | Theme → Dark |
| <kbd>t</kbd> then <kbd>s</kbd> | Theme → System |

## Dashboard

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| <kbd>[</kbd> or <kbd>ğ</kbd> | Previous resource tab |
| <kbd>]</kbd> or <kbd>ü</kbd> | Next resource tab |
| <kbd>r</kbd> | Refresh the current resource list |
| <kbd>/</kbd> or <kbd>.</kbd> | Focus the search box |
| <kbd>n</kbd> | Focus the namespace filter |
| <kbd>e</kbd> | Toggle Live Events panel |
| <kbd>Esc</kbd> | Close Live Events panel (when open) |
| <kbd>c</kbd> | Open cluster switcher (your own cluster) |
| <kbd>v</kbd> | Open Saved Views dropdown |

## Cluster switcher

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| <kbd>1</kbd> or <kbd>9</kbd> | Pick by index (1–9) |
| <kbd>↑</kbd> or <kbd>↓</kbd> | Move focus |
| <kbd>↵</kbd> | Activate focused item |
| <kbd>Esc</kbd> | Close without switching |

## Admin

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| <kbd>[</kbd> or <kbd>ğ</kbd> | Previous sub-section |
| <kbd>]</kbd> or <kbd>ü</kbd> | Next sub-section |

## Admin tables

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| <kbd>j</kbd> or <kbd>k</kbd> | Move the row cursor down / up |
| <kbd>↵</kbd> | Open the selected row |
| <kbd>d</kbd> | Delete the selected row (asks first) |
| <kbd>n</kbd> or <kbd>p</kbd> | Next / previous page |

## Log viewer

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| <kbd>p</kbd> | Toggle pause |
| <kbd>w</kbd> | Toggle word wrap |
| <kbd>⌘</kbd> then <kbd>F</kbd> | Find in the log |

## Scale modal

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| <kbd>↑</kbd> then <kbd>↓</kbd> | Replica ±1 (while input focused) |
| <kbd>⇧</kbd> then <kbd>↑/↓</kbd> | Replica ±10 (while input focused) |

## Command palette

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| <kbd>↑</kbd> then <kbd>↓</kbd> | Move selection |
| <kbd>↵</kbd> | Run selected command |
| <kbd>Esc</kbd> | Close the active modal / palette |
